usedFor: Status Hero tracks team check-ins, and “Record Member Absence” and “Create Team Holiday” keep time off right.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in Lemon Squeezy, then “Create Team Holiday” in Status Hero
bestTemplate.why: An event can mark a team day off without someone entering it.

watchOut: “Create Team Holiday” applies to the whole team, so check the date before it runs.
